description: AirSim 三车跟随任务的固定英文输入；为迁移验收目标，尚未接入执行器或通过飞行验收。

conventions.relative_direction: Relative to the target vehicle's direction of travel.
conventions.duration_rule: Maintain tracking continuously; Jev judges stage outcome within allocated budget and total task timeout.

tasks.prompt: Identify the yellow pickup truck leading the convoy. Follow it from 8 meters behind and 2 meters above its roof continuously.

tasks.target: grey-green armored vehicle in the middle of the convoy
tasks.prompt: Identify the grey-green armored vehicle in the middle of the convoy. Fly alongside it, maintaining a lateral distance of 6 meters to its left and a height of 3 meters above its roof continuously.

tasks.target: white van at the rear of the convoy
tasks.prompt: Identify the white van at the rear of the convoy. Track it from directly overhead, maintaining a height of 6 meters above its roof continuously.
